description: Issue #746: with `sprites` ACTIVE, redefining one of the profile's three turtle-identity reporters raises `ol-reserved-word`. `spec/tooling.md:185` is a normative Layer-2 "Required behavior" row -- declaring a built-in name (a keyword, a **primitive**, or an alias spelling of one) at one of the four declaration slots raises `ol-reserved-word`, and profile primitives count there whether or not their profile is claimed. `new_turtle`/`who`/`turtles` are Sprites **primitives** (`spec/turtles-and-sprites.md`'s "Canonical forms" table: each Kind-R, arity 0), so with the profile claimed they collide exactly as `grid` (Geometry), `set_tempo` (Sound), `dict` (Data), and `wait` (Interaction & Events) do. Paired with `reserved-reporters-without-sprites`, which checks this exact source with Sprites absent and expects the same diagnostics -- the profile set does not decide whether a name may be declared (`spec/grammar.md:408`). `"check": true` (semantic-checker only, no execution) because this is a checker rule: the procedures are never called and no events are produced. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: the harness strips it from BOTH sides before comparing (`scripts/harness/index.mjs:977-983`), so supplying one here would be an assertion nothing can evaluate.
